issues.title: Evaluate original COD ADM2 repair package: 3,905 cells / 50 owners
issues.body:
Evaluate the complete original `gb-COD-ADM2--repair-evaluation` from the global current-cell work queue, preserving all 3,905 original cells (3,645 land + 260 inland water), 2,323 intervals, 50 original owners and ALL 50 literal source atoms. This is historical source-relative repair qualification under #1202; accepted repair credit is currently zero.

The scope uses the original 2019 Référentiel Géographique Commun / OCHA DR Congo geoBoundaries ADM2 product at upstream `9469f09592ced973a3448cf66b6100b741b64c0d`. Original source archive is 2,215,535 bytes, SHA-256 `2cf73c7be7403b742c8e9682f7d51609485fa0e6eab01644a695a83f81a7bb5e`; its actual metadata declares CC BY 3.0 IGO, territory/city, and native WGS84 degrees. Retain original attribution, licensing evidence, archive and complete original products/competitors. The whole current country cohort has 189 owners; contact and primary context comprises 10 whole families / 537 features, before the complete foreign applicability assessment.

Current main readback is `923e9c210b59836e069c182d68daf85439096381`. Fresh exact-package search found no existing package issue. Every original interval was intersected with the actual current selected additive patch: zero overlapping cells. This is not current base-owner-zero proof or selected acceptance.

Keep the legal/current-role, roster and source-restoration questions in #870 (37 original atoms) and #878 (13 original atoms) open and separate, including restricted SALB alternatives. This package asserts no new city/territory legal role, current sovereignty or authoritative boundary status. #1694 is a separate failed five-gap / 0-result batch involving two source IDs; preserve its result and do not rerun or reuse that failed microscopic-seam conclusion.

Use stock complete source/physical work and direct native authority when the actual immutable inputs are ready. Diagnose and retain unsupported original cells only following an actual stock refusal; do not omit original water or narrow the denominator in advance. Preserve full source/owner ancestry and all original assignments, operating observations, exact authority quartet pins and substantive independent review. Current selected owner-zero, combined conservation/emitted artifacts and parent integration remain separate unexecuted acceptance gates.

Assigned author: `01a14c3a-abbc-76f5-b9e1-1e3f2cb1c024`; intended new branch `engineering/congo-original-repair-20261018`; owned namespace `coordination/engineering/congo-original-repair-20261018/`. No integration queue submission or selected composition is part of this author task.
